jobs.description: This role is open to doctors who can take shifts from the priority schedules below (minimum 8 hours/week) and interested in handling real-time, inbound patient calls through active hotline queues. Priority days/shifts: Mon-Fri 10AM-2PM Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri 4PM-8PM Wed & Thu, 3PM-7PM MedGrocer's digitally-enabled medicine programs, telehealth services, and corporate clinic medical staff work with hundreds of employers and pharma companies to improve the physical and mental health of over one million Filipinos every year. The Teleconsult Doctor is a key member of our medical team, responsible for delivering high-quality, remote medical care to patients across the Philippines. This role involves treating a wide range of patient cases, from acute conditions to chronic diseases, and providing wellness advice. As a Teleconsult Doctor, you will leverage our digital platform to make healthcare more accessible, efficient, and integrated, ensuring a seamless experience for every patient. Work Location: Remote (Work-from-Home) Onsite Training: 2 to 3 days remote or on-site in Makati Shift Commitment: Minimum of 8 hours/week Shift Length: Minimum of 4 hours/shift Compensation: ₱275/hour + ₱175 incentive per additional completed consult within the same hour (starting from the 2nd consult) Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive teleconsultations for non-emergency health concerns received through the hotline. Manage and monitor patients with chronic diseases, developing and adjust care plans through remote consultations. Assess patients' conditions and effectively redirect them to appropriate primary care networks or specialists when in-person evaluation is necessary. Issue e-prescriptions, laboratory requests, and other necessary medical documents through the platform. Maintain accurate, comprehensive, and timely patient records within our Electronic Medical Records (EMR) system. Fresh graduates are highly encouraged to apply! We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . jobs.title: Field Phlebotomy Supervisor - Northern California
jobs.description: Getlabs is the leading platform for at-home diagnostics. Healthcare organizations use Getlabs to send mobile phlebotomists to patients’ homes and collect labs, vitals, and advanced diagnostics. By leveraging Getlabs, partners can improve patient adherence and close gaps in care with same-day, nationwide availability. Our team has raised $50M from strategic investors including the two largest diagnostic laboratories in the United States, Labcorp and Quest. Getlabs’ mission is to save lives by expanding access to diagnostics for everyone. About the role: We are currently seeking a full-time Field Phlebotomy Supervisor interested in joining a high-growth stage startup. The mandate of the Field Phlebotomy Supervisor is simple but challenging: assist our Operations Manager with the day-to-day operations throughout the market and ensure our patients have the best experience possible. The Field Phlebotomy Supervisor oversees the quality of territories patient operations. You will be responsible for ensuring that every Getlabs experience meets and exceeds the patient's expectations. You will also help train and ensure quality for our team of hourly phlebotomists. Above all, we are seeking candidates who are self-starters and are resourceful, organized, detail-oriented, communicative, and friendly. This position is currently limited to candidates residing within a one-hour commute of the San Francisco Bay Area. jobs.title: Kundensupport-Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) Inbound & Outbound Telefonie
jobs.description: Über uns MY HEALTH & BEAUTY steht für moderne ästhetische Medizin auf höchstem Niveau. An unseren Standorten in ganz Deutschland begleiten wir Patientinnen und Patienten von der ersten Anfrage bis zur Nachsorge, mit erfahrenen Ärztinnen und Ärzten und einem Team, das Service großschreibt. Für unser wachsendes Kundensupport-Team suchen wir Verstärkung, die am Telefon überzeugt und Menschen gern weiterhilft. Deine Aufgaben Du nimmst eingehende Anrufe von Interessenten und Patienten entgegen, beantwortest Fragen zu unseren Behandlungen und Abläufen und bist die erste Stimme von MY HEALTH & BEAUTY. Du rufst Interessenten aktiv zurück, zum Beispiel nach Anfragen über unsere Landingpages, und begleitest sie bis zum Beratungstermin. Du vereinbarst, verschiebst und bestätigst Termine an unseren Standorten und pflegst dabei unsere Systeme sorgfältig. Du führst Nachfass- und Servicetelefonate, etwa vor und nach Behandlungen, und sorgst für ein rundum gutes Patientenerlebnis. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Ärzten, Standortteams und dem Marketing zusammen und gibst Feedback aus Kundensicht weiter. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung im telefonischen Kundenservice, Callcenter, Vertrieb oder in einer Praxis/Klinik ist von Vorteil, Quereinsteiger mit Kommunikationstalent sind ebenso willkommen. Du hast eine freundliche, sichere und verbindliche Art am Telefon und scheust dich auch nicht vor Outbound-Gesprächen. Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, weitere Sprachen (z. B. Englisch, Türkisch, Arabisch) sind ein Plus. Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und gehst diskret mit sensiblen Patientendaten um. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit PC, CRM-Systemen und Terminkalendern. Interesse an Ästhetik, Gesundheit und Beauty bringst du gerne mit. Das bieten wir dir Eine Festanstellung in einem dynamisch wachsenden Unternehmen Eine attraktive Vergütung Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung und regelmäßige Schulungen zu unseren Behandlungen Start-Up Kultur Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unsere Behandlung

jobs.title: Roving Clinic Nurse
jobs.description: About the role Remedy Skintech, Inc. is seeking an experienced Roving Clinic Nurse to join our dynamic team in Metro Manila. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you will play a crucial role in providing high-quality nursing care and support to our patients in an aesthetic clinic setting. What you'll be doing Deliver high-quality laser procedures to our patients Assist on doctors' procedures In charge of post-op procedures like equipment maintenance patients' post-treatment protocols Undergo training for all Remedy treatments Collaborating with the team to coordinate patient care and facilitate a smooth patient experience Providing patient education and promoting healthy behaviours to support positive health outcomes Maintaining a clean, safe, and well-organised clinical environment What we offer At Remedy Skintech, Inc., we value our employees and strive to create a supportive, collaborative work environment. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you can expect competitive salary, and opportunities for professional development and career advancement. About us Remedy Skintech, Inc. is a leading provider of advanced dermatological services and skincare products in the Philippines. Our mission is to empower individuals to achieve their healthiest, most radiant skin through innovative treatments and personalized care. With a team of experienced medical professionals and a state-of-the-art facility, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional patient outcomes and an unparalleled customer experience. If you're passionate about nursing and committed to making a difference in the lives of our patients, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
